frank: "Deprecated: `gpt-old`. Use `rw/<model-id>` for predictable behavior."

yasmin: agree. also please add macOS sed examples in migration note (some of our docs readers use mac).
frank: added both variants and a tiny `npm`/`pip` upgrade line.
docs-bot: preview build #5142 available at https://deployments.preview/redwood/docs/5142 :white_check_mark:

gabe: after merge, schedule docs/regenerate-snapshots so sample snapshots stay aligned.
